mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided symbolic regression and interpretable scientific equation discovery
mechanism.populationDetail: Ideas evolve independently within multiple islands, with periodic repopulation of weak islands using global-best ideas; configurations use 8 or 12 islands.
mechanism.archiveDetail: A central repository stores evaluated ideas and exposes top-performing global ideas for prompts and island repopulation; no descriptor-cell archive is specified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Evaluated ideas accumulate in the central repository, while the worst island populations are periodically repopulated from global-best ideas; tree-shaped expressions are representations, not a maintained population tree.
mechanism.generationDetail: New expressions are generated by LLM proposal agents conditioned on problem context and prior ideas; no executable parent is directly edited in the reported experiments.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Reduced chi-square is the primary per-candidate score; complexity, validity, fitted parameters/uncertainties, and optional unit checks are structured archive/report fields. Candidate rationales are generated proposal content, not evaluator-produced verbalized feedback.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Fresh LLM proposals have zero true editable solution parents; local/global ideas condition the prompt and repopulation but do not participate in active crossover or direct parent editing.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: The proposal model is allocated adaptively via a softmax bandit over recent backend success while searching a multi-island semantic ansatz space; model-routing control and fresh contextual proposal interact beyond conventional operator selection.

provenance.citationWarning: The paper is currently cited in the application section. In mechanism chapters distinguish true parents from top-idea context; reported experiments disable tree mutation/crossover. Adaptive routing chooses LLM backends, not generation mechanisms. Parallel proposals are explicit, evaluator concurrency less so.
